reference_lr_note: Starting LoRA LR for the reference model in supervised fine-tuning with about 128 sequences per batch and a few hundred steps, rank 32, linear decay. It is close to the reference model's optimum under the calibration protocol (7.4e-4) and is a compromise on the Tulu3 SFT sweep (batch 128, 780 steps, LRs a factor of 3 apart, recipes/chat_sl/results/sft_sweep.md): Qwen3-8B is best at 1e-3 or above for ranks 16-128, while the Qwen3.5 and Qwen3.6 models are best at 2.5e-4 to 4.5e-4, which is 0.6 to 0.9 times reference_lr * multiplier at rank 16 and 0.7 to 1.3 times at ranks 64-128. Loss rises faster above the optimum than below it, so the value leans low. get_lr(model) = reference_lr * multiplier(model).

protocol.name: pretrain_mix_v1
protocol.grid_note: The first seed runs 7 learning rates grid_center * 2**k for k = -3..3. The grid is extended by halving below the lowest LR while the minimum has fewer than two neighbours there, and upward (geometric midpoint toward the lowest diverged LR, else doubling) until the loss rises 1% above the minimum. Every seed then runs each LR that the fit centres its window on and two neighbours a factor of sqrt(2) apart on each side, repeated until the fit asks for no new runs.
protocol.estimator_note: The loss at each LR is the median over the seeds that ran it. opt_lr: vertex of a least-squares quadratic in log(lr) through the points within a factor of 2 of a centre. The centre starts at the lowest loss and moves to the measured LR nearest the vertex until it stops moving, so the window holds five LRs a factor of sqrt(2) apart, each run with every seed, centred on the fitted optimum. edge_lr (stored, not used for the multiplier): LR where the loss first rises 1% above the minimum on the high side.
